name: WF-425 — Closing Completion, Funds Confirmation & Deal Finalization Controller

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const leadId=String(b.leadId??'').trim(); const propertyId=String(b.propertyId??'').trim(); const dealId=String(b.dealId??'').trim(); const assignmentId=String(b.assignmentId??'').trim(); return [{json:{...b,leadId,propertyId,dealId,assignmentId,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Closing Completion Request').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const d=ctx.deal??{}; const closing=ctx.closing??{}; const settlement=ctx.settlement??{}; const funds=ctx.funds??{}; const flags=[]; const requiredEvidence={closingCompletedAt:ctx.closingCompletedAt??closing.completedAt??null,fundsConfirmed:ctx.fundsConfirmed??funds.confirmed??false,buyerFundsConfirmed:ctx.buyerFundsConfirmed??funds.buyerConfirmed??false,sellerPayoffConfirmed:ctx.sellerPayoffConfirmed??funds.sellerPayoffConfirmed??false,settlementReconciled:ctx.settlementReconciled??settlement.reconciled??false,titleClear:ctx.titleClear??ctx.title?.clearToClose??false,contractExecuted:ctx.contractExecuted??d.assignmentContractExecuted??false}; if(!requiredEvidence.closingCompletedAt)flags.push('closing_completion_timestamp_missing'); if(requiredEvidence.fundsConfirmed!==true)flags.push('funds_not_confirmed'); if(requiredEvidence.buyerFundsConfirmed!==true)flags.push('buyer_funds_not_confirmed'); if(requiredEvidence.sellerPayoffConfirmed!==true)flags.push('seller_payoff_not_confirmed'); if(requiredEvidence.settlementReconciled!==true)flags.push('settlement_not_reconciled'); if(requiredEvidence.titleClear!==true)flags.push('title_not_clear'); if(requiredEvidence.contractExecuted!==true)flags.push('assignment_contract_not_executed'); const hardBlock=['closing_completion_timestamp_missing','funds_not_confirmed','buyer_funds_not_confirmed','seller_payoff_not_confirmed','settlement_not_reconciled','title_not_clear','assignment_contract_not_executed']; const complete=flags.length===0; const lifecycleState=complete?'closed':(flags.includes('closing_completion_timestamp_missing')?'closing_pending':'closing_evidence_pending'); const decision=complete?'finalize_closed_deal':'hold_deal_open_and_collect_completion_evidence'; const finalizationRecord={dealId:input.dealId,assignmentId:input.assignmentId,propertyId:input.propertyId,closingCompletedAt:requiredEvidence.closingCompletedAt,fundsConfirmed:requiredEvidence.fundsConfirmed,buyerFundsConfirmed:requiredEvidence.buyerFundsConfirmed,sellerPayoffConfirmed:requiredEvidence.sellerPayoffConfirmed,settlementReconciled:requiredEvidence.settlementReconciled,titleClear:requiredEvidence.titleClear,contractExecuted:requiredEvidence.contractExecuted,closingReference:ctx.closingReference??closing.reference??null,settlementStatementId:ctx.settlementStatementId??settlement.statementId??null}; const idempotencyKey='wf425:'+input.leadId+':'+input.propertyId+':'+input.dealId+':'+input.assignmentId; return [{json:{...input,closingFinalization:{status:complete?'ready_to_finalize':'incomplete',lifecycleState,decision,flags,requiredEvidence,finalizationRecord,nextAction:complete?'mark_deal_closed_and_trigger_post_closing_reconciliation':'collect_missing_closing_evidence',confidenceScore:complete?100:Math.max(0,70-flags.length*9)},idempotencyKey}}];
